tour.title: Entry Point: Authentication & Authorization
tour.description: The finance module begins with robust security. Every financial route is protected by authentication and role-based access control (RBAC). Unauthorized users are redirected based on their permissions.

tour.title: Dashboard: The Financial Command Center
tour.description: After authentication, users land on the main finance dashboard. This page bootstraps initial metrics for the current month and renders a client-side interactive dashboard. It uses dynamic rendering to ensure fresh data.

tour.title: Advanced Dashboard: Suspense Zones & Intelligence
tour.description: The smart finance dashboard is divided into three suspense zones that load independently: Critical Intelligence (health score, runway, break-even), Forecast Zone (charts and aging analysis), and Detail Intelligence (advanced KPIs, scenarios, ROI). This architecture enables progressive loading for better perceived performance.

languageLesson.title: Suspense Zones Pattern
languageLesson.content: The dashboard uses React Suspense to split data loading into independent zones. Each zone is wrapped in a Suspense boundary with its own fallback skeleton. This means critical metrics can display immediately while detailed analytics load in the background, providing better perceived performance than waiting for all data.

tour.title: General Ledger: Cashflow Transaction History
tour.description: The cashflow page displays the complete general ledger with pagination and filtering capabilities. Users can filter by month/year and transaction type to analyze cashflow patterns.

tour.title: Expense Vouchers: Vietnamese Accounting Compliance
tour.description: The expense detail page renders a printable A5 landscape expense voucher document compliant with Vietnamese accounting standards. It demonstrates parallel data fetching, code generation, and localized date formatting.

languageLesson.title: Print Media Queries
languageLesson.content: The expense voucher uses CSS @media print { } queries to optimize the layout for printing. This hides navigation, buttons, and other UI chrome, while ensuring the document prints cleanly on A5 paper with proper margins. It's a standard technique for financial documents that need physical signatures.

tour.title: Expense Management: Listing & Statistics
tour.description: The expenses listing page shows all expense vouchers with monthly statistics. It provides an overview before drilling into individual expense details.

tour.title: Receipt Vouchers: Vietnamese Form 01-tt Compliance
tour.description: The receipt detail page implements the official Vietnamese receipt form (Mẫu 01-tt) per Ministry of Finance regulation TT 200/2014/TT-BTC. It displays amounts in both numeric VND format and Vietnamese words for accounting compliance.

languageLesson.title: Vietnamese Accounting Compliance
languageLesson.content: Vietnamese accounting regulations require receipts to display amounts in both numeric and word form (e.g., '1,500,000 VND' and 'Một triệu năm trăm nghìn đồng'). This dual representation prevents fraud and tampering. The system uses the readMoney utility function to convert numbers to Vietnamese words automatically.

tour.title: Currency Formatting Utilities
tour.description: The finance module uses specialized utilities for Vietnamese currency handling: formatVnd for numeric display, readMoney for text conversion, and status helpers for UI variants and localized labels.

tour.title: Receipt Management: Listing Page
tour.description: The receipts listing page provides an overview of all income receipts for the current period, passing initial data to the interactive client component.

tour.title: Budget Management: Actual vs. Planned
tour.description: The budget page compares actual spending against planned budgets, helping teams stay on track financially. It fetches budget vs actual data for the current month and year.

tour.title: Debt Tracking: Receivables & Payables
tour.description: The debts page provides comprehensive debt management, showing both receivables (money owed to you) and payables (money you owe), with aging analysis and integrity reports.

tour.title: Vendor Debt Management
tour.description: The vendor debts page tracks payment obligations to suppliers, helping manage cash flow and vendor relationships.

tour.title: Lab Debts: Photo Lab Payables
tour.description: A specialized debt tracking page for photo lab vendors, important for photography studios managing outsourced lab work.

languageLesson.title: Domain-Specific Financial Tracking
languageLesson.content: The finance module includes specialized pages like lab-debts that reflect the photography studio domain. This demonstrates how a generic financial system can be adapted with domain-specific views for better workflow and reporting.

tour.title: Salary Management: Payroll Tracking
tour.description: The salaries page manages employee payroll, displaying monthly salaries with summary statistics for the current period.

tour.title: Fixed Costs: Recurring Expenses
tour.description: The fixed costs page manages recurring monthly expenses like rent, utilities, and subscriptions that don't vary with business activity.

tour.title: Financial Goals: Target Setting & Projections
tour.description: The goals page combines financial goal tracking with cashflow projections, helping teams set targets and monitor progress.

tour.title: Investment Tracking: Long-term Assets
tour.description: The investments page manages long-term financial investments and assets, tracking performance and allocation.

tour.title: Financial Categories: Income & Expense Classification
tour.description: The categories page manages the classification system for all financial transactions, organizing income and expenses into meaningful categories for reporting and analysis.

tour.title: Financial Closes: Month-End Process
tour.description: The financial close process locks a period's transactions and generates summary reports. The closes pages manage this critical accounting workflow.

languageLesson.title: Financial Close Process
languageLesson.content: The month-end close is a critical accounting procedure where transactions for a period are locked and reconciled. This prevents backdating or modifying past transactions, ensuring audit trails and data integrity. After close, financial statements are generated and can be relied upon for decision-making.

tour.title: Data Fetching Pattern: unwrap Utility
tour.description: Throughout the finance module, you'll notice a repeated pattern: the unwrap utility function. This helper safely extracts data from ActionResult types, providing fallback values when errors occur.

languageLesson.title: Error Handling Pattern: unwrap
languageLesson.content: The finance module uses a consistent error handling pattern with the unwrap helper. Server actions return an ActionResult type that can be either { success: true, data } or { success: false, error }. The unwrap function safely extracts the data if successful, or returns a fallback value if there's an error. This pattern ensures the UI can always render, even when backend calls fail.
